scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Cindy kissing stunned Baek Seung-chan at the illuminated amusement park and telling him she will think of him whenever amusement parks come up.

scenes.title: Tell Me Once You Have Sorted Out Your Feelings
scenes.summary: Right after kissing Seung-chan, Cindy bristles when frozen Seung-chan blurts out it is his first time, asks if she looks like an emcee running the show alone, and gives him time to answer.

scenes.title: Drive Safely—Do Not Speed Just Because You Are Annoyed
scenes.summary: Stuck in traffic while fuming over hate calls, Ye-jin gets warned by Joon-mo to hurry before fireworks yet never speed out of temper, while Cindy reassures herself she was not rejected.

scenes.title: Hold On Tight—Let Us Race!
scenes.summary: Cindy scolds clueless Seung-chan for standing behind her in their selfie so her face looks bigger, confiscates his memory card, and squeals as he races her wheelchair across the park.

scenes.title: I Already Know Everything, Producer
scenes.summary: Lured back to her parked car by a call about her headlights, Ye-jin puzzles over how the caller knew her removed phone number, whacks a figure in the dark, and discovers Cindy's agency manager waiting.
scenes.location: amusement park parking lot at night

scenes.title: Going Off the Grid and Sorting Recyclables Outside?!
scenes.summary: Manager Kim explains how tailing Ye-jin led him straight to Cindy sorting recyclables outside Joon-mo's building, then reluctantly grants Ye-jin tonight so Cindy can see her birthday fireworks.

scenes.title: My Concert VIP Tickets Are Pretty Expensive!
scenes.summary: Wrapping up Cindy's birthday at a karaoke room, Seung-chan brags about automated karaoke-machine compliments, Ye-jin roasts his solemn song pick, and Cindy treats them to a special performance.

scenes.title: Nobody Else in This House Eats Quinoa and Lentils!
scenes.summary: Heading home after her three-day break, Cindy apologizes to Ye-jin for the car-vandalism trouble and slips her a generous thank-you envelope before leaving.

scenes.title: Please Keep Our Address-Sharing Secret!
scenes.summary: While sleepy Ye-joon thinks he dreamed Cindy walking out with Joon-mo, Joon-mo asks Manager Kim to keep his and Ye-jin's temporary address-sharing quiet, and Cindy reads Seung-chan's book in the van.
scenes.location: Joon-mo's apartment hallway and parking lot

scenes.title: Who Knows—Maybe Cindy Has Feelings for Seung-chan!
scenes.summary: Analyzing the cast's stagnant love lines on the whiteboard, Writer Ji-yeon pitches a romantic-comedy pairing between superstar Cindy and rookie PD Seung-chan for the Best Friends Special.

scenes.title: Cindy's Fan Club Says They Love You!
scenes.summary: Terrified that a parcel from Cindy's fan club hides a prank, Ye-jin beams from ear to ear when Il-yong shows her Cindy's affectionate post praising 'always kind Producer Tak Ye-jin.'

scenes.title: You and I Have Zero Wavelength in Common!
scenes.summary: Told to pick whatever he wants for lunch, Seung-chan suggests blood-sausage soup, gimbap, and risotto—watching Joon-mo veto every single choice before ordering spicy mixed noodles.

scenes.title: Seung-chan, Do I Seem Fierce to You?
scenes.summary: Over spicy mixed noodles, a colleague pushes Ye-jin to go on a blind date with his finance friend who likes fierce, stylish women—while Seung-chan loyally insists Ye-jin is the exact opposite of fierce.

scenes.title: If You Vanish, Your Spot Will Be Filled Right Away
scenes.summary: Refusing to name the friends she stayed with, Cindy reminds CEO Byun she is the agency's number-one asset—earning Byun's chilling warning that every star is replaceable.

scenes.title: Good Intentions Do Not Guarantee a Good Ending
scenes.summary: Seung-chan confronts Joon-mo for building a cowardly fence around Ye-jin—neither letting her come closer nor letting her go—and Joon-mo replies that you must never step in unless you can take responsibility to the very end.

scenes.title: Speaking as Another Man, That Guy Sounds Sketchy
scenes.summary: Carrying Ye-jin's fan gifts to the parking lot, Seung-chan argues against her blind-date prospect point by point and firmly forbids her from dating random men out of frustration with Joon-mo.

scenes.title: They Want Me to Moderate My Own Anti-Fan Cafe?!
scenes.summary: Seung-chan trades Ye-jin's daily cash installments for meals and movie tickets, Ye-jin checks whether Cindy's phone is back on, and Cindy gets invited to moderate her own anti-fan cafe.
scenes.location: KBS parking lot, Joon-mo's apartment, and Cindy's bedroom

scenes.title: Are Rookie Producers Too Busy to Send One Text?
scenes.summary: Ye-jin phones Cindy pretending to look for plum extract so she can check on her, and Cindy coyly asks 'for a friend' whether rookie PDs are too busy to call or text.

scenes.title: Two Men Saying the Exact Same Thing!
scenes.summary: Handing Ye-jin her misplaced phone, Joon-mo casually admits he answered and rejected her blind-date suitor's call—echoing Seung-chan's exact warning from the day before.

scenes.title: Let Us Strictly Separate Work From Private Matters
scenes.summary: Caught bare-faced when Seung-chan arrives unannounced to film the Best Friends Special, Cindy scrambles into full makeup and coolly tells Seung-chan to avoid private talk—only for him to focus purely on setting up cameras.

scenes.title: Please Tell Me CEO Byun Is Not My Surprise Best Friend!
scenes.summary: Filming the Best Friends Special intro with zero clue whom her agency invited, Cindy threatens to shut down the shoot if CEO Byun walks through the door and bluffs that she has too many close friends to name just one.

scenes.title: Do the Two of You Not Even Have Each Other's Numbers?
scenes.summary: Put on the spot when her famous rival arrives as her 'best friend,' Cindy performs sweet friendship for the cameras while fretting over two-shots—until Seung-chan asks them to text each other video letters.

scenes.title: Even If TV Is Never One Hundred Percent True, We Cannot Air a Lie
scenes.summary: Staying behind after the shoot, Seung-chan gently notes that Cindy's guest was clearly booked by the agency and questions airing a fabricated friendship, sparking Cindy's defensive pushback.

scenes.title: What Even Is My True Self?
scenes.summary: Seung-chan tells Cindy he believes she is a good person who does not value herself enough and ends up acting even her real feelings, leaving tearful Cindy asking how anyone could love her when she barely knows herself.

scenes.title: We Should Hold Company Sports Day Every Quarter!
scenes.summary: While Tae-ho frets over turning out eighty staffers for the director's popularity test and Joon-mo only attends for the catered pork buffet, rookie Seung-chan beams that KBS sports day should happen every quarter.
scenes.location: KBS variety office and sports field

scenes.title: The Goalkeeper Is Celebrating the Goal With Him!
scenes.summary: In the office soccer match, defenders part like the Red Sea for Director Jang—except clueless rookie Seung-chan, who steals the ball until a sycophantic teammate tackles him and goalkeeper Tae-ho dives the wrong way on purpose.

scenes.title: Just Dare Kick That Ball In—Stop Playing So Hard!
scenes.summary: Instead of letting the match end warmly on Director Jang's staged goal, earnest Seung-chan scores an equalizer that forces a penalty shootout—while Ye-jin yells from the sideline ordering him to miss.

scenes.title: Scouted Over a Company Soccer Match
scenes.summary: After the match, Director Jang poses for a stiff photo with Seung-chan while another variety producer phones to recruit Seung-chan for his celebrity soccer team.

scenes.title: I Have Something Urgent to Say—I Will Wait Outside Your House
scenes.summary: Rewarded by Ye-jin with his choice of payment, Seung-chan picks a movie date—only for Ye-jin's phone battery to die at the cinema while Cindy calls from outside Seung-chan's home promising to wait.
scenes.location: sports field, movie theater, and outside Seung-chan's house
